feedback: This is iteration 0, so there is no earlier race outcome or race data to cite. Nothing below is a measured result for the current geometry. My controller uses sensor weights proportional to lateral position (-1, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1) with a moderate speed and a small derivative term, which gives a conventional starting point. I have not yet had to compensate for any geometry-specific problem. The baseline row spans plus or minus 0.04 m, which I expect to cover the 25 mm tape, but that is an expectation, not evidence. For the next iteration, please hold the geometry at this baseline so that the first race measures the controller on a known platform. Once the race reports its results, the first question is whether line loss happens on the bends, which would point to sensor spacing or forward offset. The second is whether steering oscillates on the slalom, which would point to sensor spacing or sensor size. Please keep sensor_positions and wheel_track unchanged until one of those two patterns appears.
requested_changes: Hold sensor_positions, sensor_size and wheel_track at the baseline for the first race, so the controller is judged on a known platform.
If the next race shows line loss on the bends, try a forward offset of y = 0.08 for the sensors or a narrower row, such as x = plus or minus 0.02, to see whether the sensors pick up the line earlier.
If the next race shows steering oscillation on the slalom, try a narrower row of sensors (plus or minus 0.02 m) with 12 mm footprints, since the line then changes less between adjacent sensors.
